page_title: BOU 1-0 TOT | Bournemouth v Tottenham Hotspur 05/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.

90+3' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Fraser Forster pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+3' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+2' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
90+1' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.
89' Timo Werner (Tottenham) plays a one-two with Destiny Udogie, but the move breaks down.
88' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
87' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Fraser Forster.
87' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
87' The resulting corner from David Brooks (Bournemouth) is cleared.

87' David Brooks (Bournemouth) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Bournemouth have a corner.
85' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Philip Billing (Bournemouth) replacing Marcus Tavernier.
85' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Antoine Semenyo and he is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) for Evanilson.

83' Ambitious effort from Timo Werner (Tottenham). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

83' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
80' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
80' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. James Maddison is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
80' A substitution has been made. Yves Bissouma goes off and Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) comes on.
79' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
79' The total number of attempts is 12:10. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:4.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) coming on for Ryan Christie.

77' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
75' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gets a nice pass from Antoine Semenyo on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
73' The goal by Bournemouth won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
72' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
72' Evanilson (Bournemouth) finds the back of the net and gets on the scoresheet.
71' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
70' A player from Bournemouth commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
70' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

69' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
68' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared by the defence.

67' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Evanilson (Bournemouth) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.

66' What a chance that is! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!

65' Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Pedro Porro (Tottenham) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the left post.
65' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches a cross from the corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga is alert to thwart the effort.
64' Here is a change. Justin Kluivert is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).

62' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth). Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Porro is coming onto the pitch as Ben Davies (Tottenham) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Ben Davies (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' James Maddison (Tottenham) is free in the box and Heung-Min Son finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
59' Evanilson (Bournemouth) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Fraser Forster is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
59' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

59' Kepa Arrizabalaga was forced into action to thwart Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
57' Substitution. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) replaces Pape Matar Sarr.

56' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ben Davies, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
56' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

56' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.

54' Archie Gray (Tottenham) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
53' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Fraser Forster.
53' The corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is straight at the keeper, who can only punch the ball away.
53' James Maddison (Tottenham) will take the corner.
52' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
51' Archie Gray (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
51' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

50' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Yves Bissouma (Tottenham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) tries to find Dominic Solanke, but he puts too much power on the pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bournemouth.
49' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simon Hooper stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
47' Tottenham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' What a save from Fraser Forster! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
43' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
40' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
38' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
38' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
34' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) commits a foul and Simon Hooper immediately signals a free kick.
33' Dominic Solanke almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by James Maddison (Tottenham) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' A goal, which was scored by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), was disallowed due to offside.
30' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Justin Kluivert. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
29' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
28' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' The ball is cleared after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:5. 2:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' CHANCE! Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
19' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from James Maddison goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
19' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner.
19' James Maddison (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.

17' 1 - 0 Marcus Tavernier takes over corner duties and expertly finds Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
17' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

16' Evanilson (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball out. What a save! It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
13' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
12' James Maddison (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
11' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
9' James Maddison (Tottenham) and Dejan Kulusevski attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
8' What a big chance! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

6' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Kepa Arrizabalaga was alert and the score remains the same.
4' Ben Davies (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
3' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper is the one to supervise the game today.
